title: The Assay's Stamp
summary: The Assay stamps its mark on everything it weighs, and its guard-captains at the Yards carry the stamps. Haldor wants three, to know the mark by feel. Tamsin Coalbrook asked him for the same once.

steps.journal: The Assay Yards at Kell's Rest: the guard-captains lead every fifth lot. Put down three of them.

ready: Three of the Assay's stamps. Take them to Haldor at the Ashgate Forge.
done: Haldor knows the Assay's mark by feel now. He says it's badly cut, and that Tamsin said so first.
